Ctrl+click should jump to the middle frame (cmd.middle()); the driver cannot send a modifier so this drives a plain click and only asserts no crash. Ctrl-modified path is UNVERIFIED here.
control-bar button 8 -> browser Fullscreen API; logs cmd.full_screen(). requestFullscreen may reject in headless (swallowed).
